en.description:
TRUTH OR DARE SHOUTOUT – THE ULTIMATE PARTY GAME!

Get ready for laughter, surprises and hilarious challenges with Truth or Dare Shoutout!

Whether you’re hosting a party, enjoying a family games night or having fun with friends, Truth or Dare Shoutout brings everyone together for hours of entertainment.

Now available for iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Apple TV!

HOW TO PLAY

1. Add up to 8 players.
2. Let the app randomly choose whose turn it is.
3. Choose Truth or Dare.
4. Answer the question or complete the challenge.
5. Keep playing and see who is brave enough to take on the next dare!

EXCITING FEATURES

HUNDREDS OF TRUTHS AND DARES
Enjoy a huge collection of entertaining questions and challenges suitable for family gatherings, parties and games nights.

NEW VOICE ANNOUNCEMENTS
Let the app do the talking! Questions and dares can be read aloud, making the game even more entertaining.

APPLE WATCH SUPPORT
Play Truth or Dare directly from your wrist! Choose a Truth or Dare and enjoy spoken challenges on your Apple Watch.

APPLE TV SUPPORT
Bring the fun to the big screen! Perfect for parties, family gatherings and games nights.

RANDOM PLAYER SELECTION
No arguing over whose turn it is! The app randomly selects the next player.

UP TO 8 PLAYERS
Add your friends and family for even more fun.

BUILT-IN TIMER
Set a countdown to keep the game moving and add excitement to every challenge.

SOUND EFFECTS
Enjoy entertaining sounds that bring the game to life.

SHARE THE FUN
Share your favourite Truth or Dare questions with friends using your favourite apps.

REMOVE ADVERTS
Enjoy an optional in-app purchase to remove advertising from the iPhone and iPad experience.

PERFECT FOR EVERY OCCASION

Birthday parties, Christmas gatherings, family games nights, sleepovers, holidays or simply having a laugh with friends!

Download Truth or Dare Shoutout today and let the fun begin!

WHO WILL BE BRAVE ENOUGH TO CHOOSE DARE?
en.releaseNotes:
OUR BIGGEST TRUTH OR DARE UPDATE YET!

We’ve been busy making Truth or Dare Shoutout even better, with exciting new features and improvements!

NEW APPLE WATCH SUPPORT
Play Truth or Dare directly on your Apple Watch, complete with spoken questions and challenges.

APPLE TV SUPPORT
Take the fun to the big screen with Truth or Dare Shoutout on Apple TV!

NEW VOICE ANNOUNCEMENTS
The app can now read Truth questions and Dare challenges aloud for even more interactive fun.

MORE TRUTHS AND DARES
Enjoy an expanded collection of entertaining questions and hilarious challenges.

IMPROVED PLAYER SELECTION
Smoother random player selection for up to 8 players.

IMPROVED TIMER
Updated countdown controls to keep your games running smoothly.

EASIER SHARING
Share your favourite Truth or Dare questions and challenges with friends.

IMPROVED IN-APP PURCHASES
A smoother experience when upgrading to remove adverts.

PERFORMANCE IMPROVEMENTS
Bug fixes, updated code and improvements for a better gaming experience.

Perfect for parties, family gatherings and games nights!

Thank you for playing Truth or Dare Shoutout. Have fun, and don’t forget to SHOUT OUT your answer!
en.subtitle: Family fun game for all ages
